name: Cash deposits split across branches, ATMs or accounts
description: Cash is deposited in several locations, channels or accounts on the same day or over a short period so that no single deposit stands out.
fp: Businesses with multiple outlets may deposit locally at different branches.

links.name: Same-day deposits across multiple branches or ATMs
links.ctx: Cash is paid in at several branches, ATMs or agents within hours, with total value well above the amount at any one location.
links.fp: Travelling workers or customers with several workplaces may use many locations.

links.name: Structured cash deposits across many branches by multiple people
links.ctx: Many low-value cash deposits into one account from different locations, often followed by wires out.

links.name: Structured cash deposits across branches or accounts
links.ctx: Cash banked in many amounts just below reporting thresholds, often across multiple branches or personal accounts.
links.fp: Some businesses make routine daily deposits in small sums.

links.name: Structured cash deposits across branches followed by overseas settlement
links.ctx: Numerous cash deposits below thresholds by different people into one account, then wires to settlement partners.
links.fp: Cash-heavy communities and retail trades show similar patterns.
